sources.title: Starting equipment
sources.summary: Normal starting equipment comes from two places: clothes equipped when the character is created, and Captain Eir's initial handover. The rows distinguish these steps and the difficulty-specific supplies.
conditions: The initial clothing applies to every normal new character. Captain Eir's later handover supplies shared equipment and additional items determined by difficulty.
The Small Backpack is equipped during the handover; the other supplied items are received into inventory. This is a one-time starting grant, not merchant stock or a random treasure roll.
Developer quick-start inventory is a separate code path and is not included in the normal starting set.

sources.title: Dead camp
sources.summary: The destroyed camp in the starting area has deliberately scripted supplies, not just a draw from the general corpse-loot pool. Its two loot containers have different fixed contents.
conditions: Check the dead-body pile and the second wooden container separately. The Apprentice Herbalist's Belt belongs to the body-pile container, not the second container.
A separate interactable dead Unwanted is involved in the camp's quest events. The torn central tent is another distinct object, not a generic cart holding all the camp's supplies.
The guarantees below apply to the initial contents of this particular scripted camp. They do not describe every random skeleton or corpse, and do not promise replenishment after looting.
